hero.title: Trace/Inhabit · SKILL
hero.subtitle: Memory · Trace / Inhabit centers on behavior logic, role capability, and knowledge structure, exploring a longer-lasting form of digital existence, so existence no longer stays only in memory.

hero.title: Let a character live in a real device.
hero.subtitle: Memory · Inhabit Device is a desktop device that carries SoulPod character archives offline. Flash the firmware once, drop a character onto the SD card, and it stays on your desk.

showcase.title: Ten seconds of it, alive.
showcase.lead: A live-action clip: the moment a SoulPod character appears on the round display. Plays muted on loop — tap the button to enable sound.

flash.title: Firmware Flashing
flash.lead: Flash Companion firmware directly to your ESP32-S3 device from the browser.
flash.unsupported: WebSerial is not supported in this browser. Please use Chrome or Edge.
flash.soulpodReady: SoulPod ready — extract it into the personas folder on the device SD card
flash.step1Desc: Connect the device and flash the Companion firmware.
flash.step2Desc: After flashing, reconnect and read the device's config page address.
flash.step3Desc: Open the device's web config page in a new tab.
flash.step4Desc: Download the character SoulPod package, extract it onto the device SD card.
flash.addressHint: Click the link to open the device config page in a new tab. If it fails, make sure the device and computer are on the same network.
flash.addressNotFound: Could not get the device address. Make sure the device has firmware flashed and is running.
flash.soulpodImportStep1: Click "Download SoulPod" on a character card to get the zip.
flash.soulpodImportStep2: Extract the zip; confirm it contains profile.json / config.json / memories / prompt etc.
flash.soulpodImportStep3: Put the extracted folder into the personas folder on the device SD card (path /sdcard/personas/<character>/).
flash.soulpodImportStep4: Re-insert the SD card and restart the device to use the character.
flash.sectionFlashDesc: Flash the Companion firmware first (one-time operation for first use).
flash.sectionDeployDesc: Get the device config page address and import character SoulPod (repeatable).

assets.title: Make it look a little more like yours.
assets.lead: Boot animations and dialogue bubble backgrounds — download the original files and drop them into place on the SD card. No network transfer, no firmware changes.
assets.howTo: Overwrite the file with the same name on the SD card, then restart the device. Create the target folder manually if it does not exist.

notes.bootDefaultNote: The production default — 3.05 MB, right around the recommended 3 MB ceiling. Recommended.

toDevice.title: Put the character into a device
toDevice.desc: The SoulPod archive produced by Trace / Inhabit can be imported straight into Inhabit Device, so the character keeps you company offline on your desk.

toSkill.title: Get a character archive first
toSkill.desc: The device needs a SoulPod archive to work. Use Trace / Inhabit to extract a character from novels or scripts.
